_readme: Hand-picked course photos. This file outranks the crawl and the crawl never writes it.
Produced by scripts/make_photo_picker.py: open data/photo_picker.html, click the
picture you want for each course, then Download photos.curated.json and drop the
result here. Read by build_directory.py, which puts the winner on each venue's
"venue-id": { "image": null }              show no picture at all
A null is a deliberate hold, not a blank: it means every candidate was wrong and
nothing is better than the wrong thing. build_directory.py tests membership, not
truthiness, so a null beats the crawl instead of falling through to it.
A venue_id absent from this file falls back to whatever the crawl proposed.
